release.content: pubkit 0.12.5 was released on 2026-10-23 from commit a8c93a61d2c1e0911868376760f9b6ecdb3e2d25 with these changes.

rows: Generated CI for a utility: with a ci block in pubkit.json, pubkit sync writes pr.yml, main.yml and nightly.yml, each calling only the jobs that event runs, so no job shows as skipped. Each job is its own reusable workflow (job-node-test.yml, job-node-browser.yml, job-node-audit.yml, job-python-functional.yml, job-python-browser.yml, job-python-audit.yml, job-osv.yml, job-review.yml, job-sonar.yml). ci.events, ci.with, ci.jobs (narrow a job's events, or false), ci.language and ci.release configure it; checks keep their names (ci / passed, release / release). pubkit init --kind=utility writes "ci": {} in place of a seeded ci.yml, and the nightly moves ci.release.pubrel in pubkit.json
